home.how.title: A draft route in three turns. Then refine it on the route.
home.how.step1.title: Describe.
home.how.step1.body: Write the city and the trip you have in mind in your own words. No forms.
home.how.step2.title: Answer two questions.
home.how.step2.body: At most two questions per turn, each with options you can tap: dates, pace, interests.
home.how.step3.title: Your route, on the map.
home.how.step3.body: By the third turn your day-by-day draft is on the map. From there we refine it on the route itself.
home.features.title: Plan it, share it, take it with you.
home.features.planner.title: Day-by-day planner.
home.features.planner.body: Add stops to days, drag to reorder, see each day's time and distance.
home.features.optimize.title: Route optimisation.
home.features.optimize.body: Reorder your stops automatically in one tap, shortening the order by straight-line distance.
home.features.assistant.title: AI travel assistant.
home.features.assistant.body: Build and edit your route by chatting. Place details come from data, never made up.
home.features.share.title: Secure location sharing.
home.features.share.body: Time-limited, consent-based share links and codes.
home.features.messages.title: Messaging.
home.features.messages.body: Real-time chat with your travel companions.
home.features.community.title: Community.
home.features.community.body: Discover routes and guides shared by travellers.
home.independence.title: We don't sell tickets. We're with you.
home.independence.sub: MapsBridge isn't a booking engine. We own no inventory, and no one can buy a place in our suggestions.
home.independence.p1.title: No commission-based ranking.
home.independence.p1.body: Suggestions are ordered only by your interests, quality and fit with the route.
home.independence.p2.title: Prep lives in its own tab.
home.independence.p2.body: Links for stays or transport sit in a separate Prep tab, never inside route suggestions.
home.independence.p3.title: No made-up places.
home.independence.p3.body: Addresses, hours and coordinates come from sources; the assistant only understands your intent and explains.
home.credits.title: Credits are only used when the AI works.
home.credits.sub: Credits are reserved before an action starts and refunded automatically if it fails. Adding, reordering and sharing stops on the map costs nothing.
home.share.title: Did someone send you a location or a route?
home.share.sub: Enter the share code; if it's still valid and approved, it opens on the map. No account needed to view.
home.share.label: Share code
home.share.error: A code is 4–64 letters, digits or hyphens
home.mobile.title: Your route, on your phone too.
home.mobile.sub: The same planner, assistant and account on iOS and Android.
home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.q1: Can I try it without an account?
home.faq.a1: Yes. Describe your trip, answer the first questions and add stops on the map; your draft stays on your device. You need a free account for the AI to build your route.
home.faq.a2: Only on our servers, reserved just before a paid AI action starts and refunded automatically if it fails. Clarifying your preferences is free.
home.faq.a3: No. Nothing is ranked by commission; prep links sit in a separate tab and never affect the order of suggestions.
home.faq.a4: Your planned route's stops, coordinates, days and order are stored in this device's browser; if your connection drops, the stop list stays visible on the open page. Directions and map imagery are not stored and need a connection.
home.faq.a5: Turkish and English. We detect yours automatically and you can switch any time.

how.lead: Every step from describing your trip to sharing your route: talking to the assistant, the day-by-day planner, time-limited sharing and credits.
how.talk.title: The conversation: a draft route in three turns
how.talk.sub: The assistant never hands you a form. It asks at most two questions per turn, each with 2–4 options you can tap.
how.talk.turn1.title: Describe
how.talk.turn1.body: Write where you want to go and what kind of trip you have in mind, in your own words. The first turn asks for the length or your dates and the character of the trip.
how.talk.turn2.title: Settle the details
how.talk.turn2.body: The second turn asks about your pace and interests. Clarifying your preferences costs no credits.
how.talk.turn3.title: Draft route
how.talk.turn3.body: On the third turn it stops asking and shows a day-by-day draft on the map. Building the route is an AI action: it needs a free account and uses credits.
how.talk.turn4.title: Refine on the route
how.talk.turn4.body: From then on you work on the route, not a form: add, remove or reorder stops, or ask the assistant for changes in the chat.
how.planner.title: The planner: your route, day by day
how.planner.sub: The assistant's draft and the stops you add yourself meet in the same planner. You can add stops on the map without an account too.
how.planner.days.title: Stops split into days
how.planner.days.body: Each day has its own colour and stop list; add stops by searching for a place or tapping the map.
how.planner.order.title: Reorder by dragging or with buttons
how.planner.order.body: Reorder stops by dragging or with Move up / Move down; it works with the keyboard too.
how.planner.optimize.title: Optimise the route
how.planner.optimize.body: Reorders the selected day's stops to shorten the total distance. The order is worked out on your device and costs no credits.
how.planner.device.title: Stops stay on your device
how.planner.device.body: Your stops, their coordinates, days and order are stored in this browser, so your list stays visible if the connection drops. Directions and map imagery need a connection.
how.share.title: Sharing: time-limited and consent-based
how.share.sub: You share a location or a stop and choose how long it stays visible.
how.share.create.title: Create a link or a code
how.share.create.body: Create a share for a stop in the planner; links and codes are created with your account.
how.share.open.title: Open with a code
how.share.open.body: The recipient opens the link or types the code into the share field on the home page. No account is needed to view it.
how.share.expiry.title: It closes when time is up
how.share.expiry.body: You choose the duration: 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days. When it ends, the link and code no longer open.
how.credits.title: Credits: only when the AI works
how.credits.sub: Credits are only reserved on our servers, just before a paid AI action starts, and refunded automatically if it fails.
how.independence.title: We stay independent
how.independence.ranking.title: No commission-based ranking
how.independence.ranking.body: Suggestions are ordered only by your interests, quality and fit with the route.
how.independence.prep.title: Prep lives in its own tab
how.independence.prep.body: Links for stays or transport sit in the assistant's separate Prep tab, never inside route suggestions.
how.faq.title: The details
how.faq.q1: Why does the assistant ask at most two questions per turn?
how.faq.a1: Every question should actually change your route. So there are at most two per turn, each with 2–4 options, and on the third turn you get a draft route instead of more questions.
how.faq.q2: How long are the answers I give without an account kept?
how.faq.a2: Only on this device, for at most 7 days. The draft holds only your trip intent, no personal data. When you sign up or sign in the assistant restores it; no paid request starts until you send it.
how.faq.q3: Who can open a share link?
how.faq.a3: Anyone with the link or code, until the time you chose runs out. No account is needed to view it; once it expires it no longer opens.
how.faq.q4: Where does place information come from?
how.faq.a4: Addresses, opening hours and coordinates come from data sources; the assistant never makes them up. Its job is to understand your intent and explain the route.
how.faq.a5: No. The planner's optimisation recalculates the selected day's stop order on your device and costs no credits.
how.final.title: You don't need an account to try it
how.final.sub: Describe your trip or start adding stops on the map; your draft waits on your device.
